label: Basement Guest Fan Recovery
info: Modern Forms fan.basement_fan + light.basement_light. Supply: light.master_bath_fan_zooz_relay (Zooz). Poll live HA every 30s. Either unavailable/unknown for 2m while supply ON -> off 30s -> on -> wait 3m. Maximum 2 attempts, persistent lockout until both healthy 10m. Intentional supply OFF is respected. Restore power is prioritized across deploys/restarts; turn-on failures bounded to 3. Pushover only global.BradPhoneNM; no broadcast fallback. Source and tests: /home/pi/home_config/basement-fan-recovery. User confirmed actual supply entity despite misleading master-bath name.

nodes.name: Recovery: max 2 / persistent lockout
